notes.title: ver 1.03.00
notes.content:
Update
ver 1.03.00

Version number has been changed to match the Switch version.
(This version will be updated as ver 1.0.3)
Changed so that recovery is not staged when campers are at full life.
Fixed some red and blue blocks on the Nightmare map.
The addition of Miracle Power has been changed so that it spans across scenarios.
(For example, if you have 4 extra Miracle Powers when clearing a scenario and the additional effect is "Miracle Power +3", 3 will carry over to the next scenario and 1 will carry over to the last chapter)
Fixed a problem in the battle line at the top of the battle, where the character icons that bounce.
Fixed a case where Rudy is a member of the group but the torch cannot be acquired.

tags.balance_change: Changed so that recovery is not staged when campers are at full life.

tags.bug: Fixed some red and blue blocks on the Nightmare map.
